purpose: transfer test: does the momentum candidate work on a DIFFERENT market (crypto)?

design.universe: 25 USD-quoted pairs with >=400 daily bars (excluded 37 non-USD quotes)
design.book: top-5 equal weight, long-only (crypto cannot be shorted), benchmark equal-weight-all
design.sensitivity: top-10 reported separately, not a gate
design.overlay: exposure = min(1, medianVol / trailing-6m realized vol of the book)
design.notTransferable: candidate A (value) needs accounting fundamentals — crypto has none; it is transferred to a different equity slice instead

caveat: crypto daily history on this plan starts 2021-01, so DEV is 2021-2022 only; the long-only form loses the short leg that carries part of the momentum premium in the literature
